parsed.rationale_overall: System A more directly addresses the user's query about tech concentration with stronger personalization (citing education goal, 10-year horizon, loss comfort) and provides better-grounded, query-relevant recommendations including 529 planning and asset location optimization. System B offers more concrete dollar amounts and broader sector diversification suggestions, but includes a questionable framing of the mortgage/liabilities as a 'debt-to-asset' constraint and a less query-relevant 'hold' recommendation.
